title: Vault mobile polish: six small defects
acceptance: Roster tile Link no longer suppresses the keyboard focus ring (players.index.tsx; test in players.index.test.tsx)
Shelf wrapper scroll offset clears the sticky site header incl. safe-area inset so View set lands with the title visible (class assertion test)
Rearrange mode hides the Sort & filter chip on the Roster header and it returns afterwards (test)
Sort sheet description reads 'How your binder reads. Kept on this phone.' (vault-sort-sheet.test.tsx)
A failed secrets read shows a one-line 'Couldn't read…' panel with a Try again button wired to secrets.refetch(); nothing shown on success; no set counts revealed (test)
Vault hero sync 'Try again' link has a 44px tap target (min-h-11 inline-flex) (vault-hero.test.tsx)
No change to rarity vocab, storage keys, aria roles/labels used by e2e, text sizes, or any src/components/ui file

REVISED #3: in rearrange mode the Sort & filter chip collapses to icon-only (aria-label and button role kept) instead of being hidden, because the chip is the only way to reach 'Done rearranging' (tests in players.index.test.tsx and vault-sort-sheet.test.tsx)

notes.text: Builder deviated from criterion 3 as first written (hide chip) because hiding it would trap the user in rearrange mode; Director verified and accepted the compact-icon alternative.
